Standing us the upright pre-combat position of your character as opposed to sitting. A character can walk, run, jump, or engage in combat directly from a standing position. If the character is sitting, most actions will automatically change the position to standing. It takes a short amount of time to stand from a sitting position and about equal amount of time to sit from a standing position, but almost no time to walk, run, jump, or engage in combat.

The Stagnant Oasis is an oasis located between the Merchant Coast and the Gold Road. In addition to Kolkar centaur camped on its fringes and other indigenous oasis flora, it is also home to several Lost Barrens Kodos, which due to their weakened state and solitary nature are much easier to hunt than the kodo of the Field of Giants to the south. The Stagnant Oasis can be fished for Deviate Fish which can be valuable when cooked into Savory Deviate Delights. Oasis Snapjaws are also indigenous here. During the Primalists' attack, the area was invaded by elementals. Their presence imbued the centaur.

The Standard of Unity is the middle option among the three "guild banners" that can be placed on the ground to provide an experience, honor, and reputation gain bonus to guild members (including the user) that remain within the area. Guild banners do not stack with each other; only the highest single guild banner bonus will apply. The only difference between the versions is the amount of the bonus. Only rewards from kills receive a bonus; quests and battleground victories are unaffected. It is possible for the banner to disappear as soon as there are no targets within its area of effect.

Stampeding Felsteeds are felsteeds that run up the Infernal Causeway on the Broken Shore while the world quest Rolling Thunder (quest) is available. They continuously spawn at Impsorrow Approach and run up the length of the causeway before despawning just north of Deliverance Point, knocking down anyone that gets in their way. During the world quest, players must navigate a Barrel of Storm Brew through the stampede and dodge the felsteeds in order to avoid taking damage. Some of the felsteeds have riders in the form of imps hanging on to their manes.
